meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: Finds, reads, and reconstructs coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi, and other local agent logs. Use when asked to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找编码助手的历史会话,还原此前做过什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要找回之前 AI 编程会话干了什么,避免重复劳动。
copy.tagline_en: Find past coding-agent sessions and see what was done before
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use coding agents and need to recover what an earlier session did.

howto.what: 当你回忆或查询过去的编码助手会话时,Claude 会在你本机保存的各种编码助手日志中跨平台搜索,然后读出匹配会话的首尾提问、时间和子代理信息,并给出原始文件路径供核对,而不是直接凭记忆回答。
howto.when: 当用户回忆或查询某次过去的编码会话,例如问“前几天我改了什么”“是否做过某项迁移”“某次修复是什么时候”等,或明确要求搜索某条历史记录时,都会触发本技能。

say.text: 帮我找找上周关于登录模块的会话记录。
say.note: Claude 会在本机各编码助手的日志里搜索并列出匹配会话。

say.text: 前几天我好像修过 OpenCode 的一个 bug,查查当时改了什么。
say.note: 它会用多个关键词搜索,必要时包含子代理会话。

say.text: 我们之前迁移过数据库吗?把所有相关会话都翻出来。
say.note: 会搜索委派给子代理的工作,并给出完整过程。

howto.what_en: When asked about past coding-agent sessions, Claude searches many local agent logs, reads the matching prompt, timestamps, and subagents, and gives the raw file path—instead of answering from memory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about past coding-agent sessions, e.g., 'what did I work on a few days ago?', 'did we migrate X?', 'when did I fix Y?', or explicitly ask to search historical session logs.

say_en.text: Find me sessions about the login module from last week.
say_en.note: Claude searches local logs and lists matching sessions.

say_en.text: I think I fixed an OpenCode bug a few days ago; check what I changed.
say_en.note: It expands search terms and includes subagent records.

say_en.text: Did we ever migrate the database? Pull up all related sessions.
say_en.note: It searches delegated work and returns the full history.
